decisions.reason: Korean 거기 is “there,” and P3 answers with 여기 (“here”); SOL flattens the contrast.
Same dismissal of 혹시, with punchier spoken rhythm than the gloss-like BASE line.
변했다 is “turned,” and “poisoned by shit” is more natural crude English for 똥독 than the calque “shit poisoning.”
Keeps the 아아 realization as one spoken beat instead of a choppy two-sentence split.
뒤로 좀 갑시다 is a physical “back up,” and 혼자만 points at Sangshik among the other scouts; BASE’s “take a step back / we’re not” reads as de-escalation.
뒷걸음질 is backpedaling; “backed away” is the right physical verb, “retreated” is only a stiffer synonym.
Adding “you” is the natural English for 약속드립니다 without changing the pitch.
SOL drops 이럴 게 아니라 (“instead of doing this here”) and turns the trailing 말씀을…… into a finished question.
“I had … in my hands” is cleaner English for 내 손에는 … 들려 있었다.
“Strange new feeling” naturalizes 신기하면서도 묘한, and “before my eyes” matches 눈앞.
“Recognition from society as” avoids the brief misparse of “society’s recognition as a mid-level Hunter.”
그렇게 is the causal “that was how,” and 접어들 is stepping onto a path, not “set out down.”
Same unconditional offer, in tighter recruitment idiom than the if-clause calque.
네 here is a perfunctory brush-off; “sure” fits the later “I’m not going to call” better than “yes.”
달라붙는 is clinging and 막아섰다 is blocking; SOL weakens both to “crowding / held back.”
Keeps 저렇게까지 / 상대로 as “that far for,” and restores the 는데 contrast SOL heard but BASE split away.
decisions.replacement: They didn’t usually go that far for a C-rank Hunter, but I was such a rare case that I seemed to be drawing a lot of attention.

decisions.reason: “Make quite a jump” is more natural English for 껑충 뛰었으니 without losing the leap.
“Tugging at my lips” matches 올라가는 입꼬리; “Even then” already covers 이 와중에도.
허 is a short dry scoff; “Heh” is closer than “Hah.”
헛웃음 is a hollow laugh; “disbelieving” names an emotion the source leaves implicit.
Keeps SOL’s “rambled on / Once” but restores US “done to me”; SOL’s “done me” is stiffer.
decisions.replacement: Kim Sangshik rambled on, spilling out every wrong he’d done to me in the past. Once his untimely confession was over, he finally got to the point.

decisions.reason: “All of it” and “all that” are interchangeable for 다; no real gain.
Keeps SOL’s idiomatic 어감, but 라서 is “because,” not “when.”
decisions.replacement: It had a nice ring to it. The feeling was terrible. Even more so because the business partner was Kim Sangshik and Sopung Guild.

decisions.reason: “Won’t be desperate to have you” clarifies 아쉬울 게 없어요, and the last line naturalizes 딱 그 정도 대우.
어디서 얼마를 부르든 is whoever/wherever, so “anyone else” is more precise than “they.”
모양이다 is “seemed,” not the stronger inference “must have been.”
Opening “And” carries the 도 from the Guild Master to Sangshik.
“His standing in the Guild” is the natural rendering of 길드 내 평가.
Both drop 기대감; SOL’s mouth-corners are right, but need the anticipation that lifts them.
decisions.replacement: The corners of my mouth rose in anticipation of what would happen when the Guild Master, notorious for his temper, found out.

decisions.reason: 생각해 is “think,” 허심탄회하게 is “openly,” and 지금 오고 계시…… is interrupted “on his way here right—,” not “already.”
decisions.replacement: “Just think about it positively. Actually, forget standing around here. Why don’t we go somewhere decent and talk openly? The Guild Master is on his way here right—”

decisions.reason: Keeps the two-beat insult-then-condition of 꼴도 보기 싫은 인간 / 그 인간 하나만.
와락 일그러진 is a twisted face; BASE’s “in fury” adds an emotion the line does not name.
악연 is old bad blood, not “an old enemy”; SOL also adds unsupported “deep” and a full “I felt.”
깔았다 covers both objects, but English sets up a grill rather than laying one out.
성의 is sincerity; SOL’s “heartfelt gesture / in recognition” is too formal for Jinho.
소주잔을 기울였다 is tilting glasses, not knocking drinks back.
“Possibly” carries the dismissive 이나 in 몇 푼이나 된다고.
피식 is a short puff of laughter, not merely a little one.
웃어야지 그럼 answers “you’re laughing?” as “of course I am,” not the stiff “I should laugh.”
일당 is a day’s pay; SOL’s “a single day” drops the wage sense.
일단은 is “for now”; SOL invents “call it ten million.”
얼핏 들으면 is “if you only heard that,” and the 총무/국무총리 pun needs the footnote SOL strips.
가져와 is “bring”; “show” is only a synonym, not an improvement.
The line is “it was the message,” not that the phone “showed” it.
Glossary binds 명품충 to Designer-Brand Junkie; neither candidate uses it. 이건 is “this.”
문자 내용을 확인한 is finishing reading the message, not “finishing the message.”
정신을 차려 is coming to one’s senses, not waking as “came to” suggests.
번갈아 is back and forth, and after the handoff the phone is in Jinho’s hand.
Same 긴데/명줄 short-long joke, in spoken English rather than the stiff “lifespan.”
“Nothing more than” intensifies 거짓말로 남는; BASE already has the sense.
재각성의 행운 is the luck of a reawakening; SOL drops luck and adds “power.”
절차 is procedure; “process” is an unforced synonym.
물기 is moisture; SOL’s “tears” jumps the reveal before the dropped tear in P138.
우냐? is a question; SOL turns it into a statement.
툭 떨어지는 is a tear that fell, but 벅벅 문지르다 is rubbing, not scrubbing.
decisions.replacement: He turned away with an unnecessary curse, but he couldn’t hide the single tear that fell. I watched him out of the corner of my eye as he roughly rubbed his face with his sleeve.

decisions.reason: 가슴 한구석 is a corner of the chest; SOL drops it and adds unsupported “strange.”
“We had lived” and “We’d lived” are indistinguishable here.
잘됐어 is a clipped “Good for you”; SOL expands it into an explanation he does not say.
고작 is “just,” and 켜켜이 쌓여 is stacked, not merely piled.
포옹 among these two on a rooftop is a hug; “embraced” is a register lift.
꼭 줘라 needs the spoken recipient “pay me.”
피식 웃음이 나왔다 is a short laugh that escaped him, matching the involuntary 나왔다.
마지막의 장난 is the last prank, not a generic “joke.”
표현 방식 is a way of expressing himself, not merely “showing it.”
그때만큼은 is “at that moment,” not the vaguer “for a moment there.”
버티고 또 버텨 is hold on and keep holding on; SOL drops the repetition and adds “no matter what.”
SOL’s “simply” is not in 당연한 것이 되어 버렸다.
The hanging 그리고 into 띠링 reads as “And then—” rather than a dead stop.
A named Status Effect takes “the” in the System line.
정체불명 is unidentified, not mysterious; “piece-of-junk” is the natural 고물.
decisions.replacement: It had all started with that unidentified piece-of-junk game capsule.

decisions.reason: 보이든, 보이지 않든 is already “Visible or not”; SOL only lengthens it.
느꼈다 is that he felt his eyelids grow heavy; SOL drops the feeling.
Keep 창밖/풀벌레, but insects chirp in English; BASE’s “crying” is a Korean calque, SOL drops “grass.”
decisions.replacement: Outside the window, the grass insects chirped loudly. My vision darkened, and sleep poured over me.

decisions.reason: 조장, 조장! is a title with a comma and a final bang; BASE under-punctuates, SOL doubles the exclamation.
“Weirdly, just hearing it” matches 이상하게 듣는 것만으로도; SOL pulls 주인 into the first sentence.
Keep BASE’s present 왜 갑자기 이럴 때 and trailing ellipsis, but title-case Squad Leader with H074.
decisions.replacement: “Why is the Squad Leader suddenly like this now of all times…”

decisions.reason: 노이즈가 꼈고 is static mixed in, not “full of static.”
The 총무/국무총리 pun still needs the footnote; deleting it leaves the joke unexplained.
